TL;DW Executive Summary:
This fireside chat dissected the common misconceptions surrounding alpha, distinguishing between simple excess returns against a benchmark and the more rigorous definition of idiosyncratic performance relative to a pricing model.
We detailed how beta serves as a measure of exposure to broader market regimes, and why relying on high-beta strategies often masks the lack of genuine skill, leaving investors vulnerable to systematic drawdowns.
Through the lens of regression analysis and scatter plots, we illustrated how alpha manifests as an intercept shift—a result of strategic positioning and capitalizing on pricing inefficiencies rather than mere luck or directional betting.
Ultimately, you saw how institutional-grade risk management involves engineering portfolios with explicit hedge sleeves to monetize volatility, demonstrating that true alpha is found in structured, orthogonal payoffs that survive even when the market "crashes the car".

I hope you enjoyed, and I hope you learned something!

Roman
